algorithm_portfolio.checkpoint_policy: Same immutable post-event RunState for every attempt; canonical difference state retained. MCU writes, invocation counters and queued events are staged in each candidate and only committed once; failed event closure also restores the checkpoint.
algorithm_portfolio.exhaustion_policy: Stop at last committed event; no SPICE fallback, no 1 ns rounding, no tolerance relaxation.
algorithm_portfolio.scope: Three registered candidates only; raw equation elimination operators evaluated in canonical checkpoint coordinates, not an exact replay of the historical raw-state solver.
algorithm_portfolio.validation: Inherited entry/endpoint checks plus original unstatically-eliminated algebraic equations and physical q/phi derivatives at start, midpoint, endpoint; engineering sampled checks, not a continuous-time certificate.

report.breakpoint_policy: FIRST_PLUS_ATOM; execute at latest member; verify each knot at its own prediction

report.event_timing_policy: First+T_atom fixed window, execute at latest member, validate every PWA at own prediction; no absolute time-error veto; exact software deadlines unchanged
report.model_contract: piecewise-affine modes; explicit transition dynamics where needed; nonzero crossing derivatives; unsupported degeneracy stops safely
